title: HC verdict in favour of ‘No Cap’ a blow to Keralam UDF govt.’s undeclared censorship of news portals: Pinarayi Vijayan

ai.summary: Kerala High Court ruled in favor of digital media outlet 'No Cap', which Pinarayi Vijayan called a blow to UDF government's alleged undeclared censorship of news portals. The court confirmed the government requested Meta to block KIFA's Facebook page.

facts.claim: Kerala High Court ruled in favor of digital media outlet 'No Cap'
facts.quote: The Kerala High Court verdict in favour of the digital media outlet ‘No Cap’ is a major blow to the United Democratic Front (UDF) government’s undeclared censorship that seeks to shackle independent journalism and freedom of expression

facts.claim: Pinarayi Vijayan called it a blow to UDF government's alleged undeclared censorship
facts.quote: It is a mere delusion on the part of the UDF government to believe that they can suppress criticism and popular protests through the use of state power

facts.claim: The court confirmed the government requested Meta to block KIFA's Facebook page
facts.quote: the High Court verdict on Wednesday also confirms that it was the government itself that requested Meta to completely block the Facebook page of the Kerala Independent Farmers Association (KIFA)

ai.background_note: Kerala High Court ruled in favor of digital media outlet 'No Cap' against UDF government's alleged undeclared censorship of news portals, confirming government requested Meta to block KIFA's Facebook page.
